name: Canvas Resize modal scales canvas dimensions with anchor grid and aspect lock
description: Verify opening the Canvas Resize modal from the header, choosing quick dimension presets (e.g. 64x64), toggling aspect ratio lock and anchor positions, and applying canvas boundary resizes.

planSteps.description: Click the canvas dimension indicator button in the top header (e.g. '32x32' or 'Resize Canvas')
Verify the 'Resize Canvas & Frame Bounds' modal appears showing presets (16, 24, 32, 48, 64, 128) and a 3x3 anchor grid
Click the '64x64' preset button in the quick dimension presets row
Verify the width and height input values update to 64
Click the center anchor cell in the 3x3 anchor grid
Verify the modal closes and the center canvas updates to 64x64 dimensions
